theme.description: Deep void backgrounds with electric blue accents and subtle gradients. High contrast for code readability.

heading.usage: Main headings, section titles, modal headers

code.usage: Code snippets, terminal outputs, generated code preview

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 h-10 px-4 py-2 rounded-md transition-all shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(37,99,235,0.3)] hover:shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(37,99,235,0.5)]
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-secondary/80 h-10 px-4 py-2 rounded-md transition-all
buttons.ghost: hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground h-10 px-4 py-2 rounded-md transition-all

cards.project: bg-card border border-border rounded-xl p-6 hover:border-primary/50 transition-all hover:shadow-lg group relative overflow-hidden
cards.chat_bubble_user: bg-primary text-primary-foreground rounded-2xl rounded-tr-sm px-4 py-3 max-w-[85%]
cards.chat_bubble_ai: bg-muted text-foreground rounded-2xl rounded-tl-sm px-4 py-3 max-w-[85%] border border-border

inputs.chat: bg-background border-border focus:ring-primary rounded-xl min-h-[60px] resize-none p-4 shadow-inner

preview_frame.container: w-full h-full bg-white rounded-lg border border-border shadow-2xl overflow-hidden relative
preview_frame.header: h-10 bg-gray-100 border-b border-gray-200 flex items-center px-4 gap-2

icons.usage: Use Lucide icons for all UI elements. Use simple, clean strokes.

universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI slop' - no generic gradients or centered layouts without purpose.
Use 'Outfit' font for headings to give a modern tech feel.
Ensure high contrast for code blocks (JetBrains Mono).
Do not use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns or overlays.
Implement a 'Split View' for the builder: Chat on Left (25%), Preview on Right (75%).
The Preview pane should look like a browser window (address bar, controls).
instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Install 'lucide-react' and 'sonner'. 2. Update 'tailwind.config.js' with the new colors and fonts. 3. Create the 'ProjectCard', 'ChatInterface', and 'PreviewFrame' components first. 4. Use the provided image URLs for backgrounds. 5. Ensure the 'Builder' page has a resizable or fixed split layout.
